breakdown.description: The pressure field is floating because no reference pressure is set. For an incompressible simulation to converge, pressure must be fixed at least at one point, typically the outlet, with a `fixedValue` condition. Setting all pressure boundaries to `zeroGradient` will lead to a solver failure.
breakdown.reason: The inconsistency was about the pressure (p) field requiring a fixed reference value. The generated specification only addresses the velocity (U) boundary condition and completely ignores the critical issue with the pressure setup. The pressure field remains floating, and the problem is not resolved.
